**Summary:** Loads and parses a scene file by name, searching registered audio entry paths and a linked list of resource locations. Opens file with "rb" mode, calls SceneFileTopLevelParser. Part of scene file loading system.

**Guard conditions:** If input filename a2 is empty string, logs "Illegal scene file name" error and returns -1. Tries opening file directly; if fails, searches audio entry array (byte_8B5A3C, stride 0x84, count dword_8B8E30) prepending each path. If still not found, walks linked list (dword_8B8F14) comparing names via sub_560230. If all searches fail, logs "Could not locate scene file" and returns -1.
